title: Equity Research Analyst
description:
About the Company

ZeTheta Algorithms Private Limited is a FinTech start-up which has been recently set up and is developing innovative AI tools.




About the Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated student intern for an Equity Research Analyst role. This is an extraordinary opportunity for a self-driven, analytically skilled student with an interest in financial markets, company valuation, and investment analysis.




About the Internship

As an Equity Research Analyst intern, you will work on cutting-edge AI-driven projects involving financial modelling, company valuation, sector analysis, and investment recommendations. You will have the opportunity to engage in multiple mini-projects across various industry sectors. The internship is designed to provide practical exposure to equity research methodologies and investment analysis.




Key Responsibilities

 1. As part of the internship, you will work through a structured set of assignments designed to enhance your understanding of equity markets and investment analysis. Your primary responsibilities will include the following.
 2. Financial Analysis and Valuation: Conduct fundamental analysis of publicly traded companies. Build and maintain financial models for company valuation. Analyse quarterly and annual financial statements. Develop comprehensive DCF, comparable company, and precedent transaction analyses.
 3. Industry and Market Research: Monitor and analyse industry trends and market dynamics. Track macroeconomic indicators affecting equity markets. Prepare sector-specific research reports. Identify potential investment opportunities through thematic research.
 4. Investment Recommendation: Formulate investment theses based on research findings. Generate buy/sell/hold recommendations with price targets. Assess risk factors and sensitivities in investment recommendations. Create comprehensive equity research reports.
 5. Data Analytics and AI Applications: Leverage AI-powered tools for data analysis and pattern recognition. Apply quantitative techniques to financial data. Work with proprietary market intelligence platforms. Extract insights from alternative data sources.
 6. Capstone Project: Prepare a comprehensive equity research report including company valuation, industry analysis, investment recommendation with rationale, and risk assessment.




What You Will Learn

Practical methodologies for equity research and financial analysis. Hands-on experience with financial modelling and valuation techniques. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills for investment decision-making. Research report writing and presentation skills. Knowledge of AI applications in financial analysis.




Who Should Apply

Student or fresh graduate from any academic discipline. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Interest in financial markets and company analysis. Willingness to self-learn and work in a fast-paced environment.




Internship Details

Duration: Self-paced. Options of 15 days, 1 month, 2 months, 4 months, or 6 months.

Type: Unpaid.




Application Process

Join us through online enrolment — simply submit your updated CV. We do not conduct any interview or assessment. All motivated early career talent are welcome to take up the role.

title: Software Development Engineer Intern
description:

Students with a college email use it free. Paid plans start at ₹399 a month.

About This Role

Job Description

Sound biological reasoning depends on correct application of scientific principles across molecular, cellular, and organismal levels — the same discipline AI systems need to learn before they can be trusted with life-science content. Chegg is seeking biology professionals to evaluate AI-generated content, build authoritative reference answers, and flag flawed scientific reasoning. Fully remote and asynchronous.

Core Responsibilities

 * Evaluate AI-generated responses to biology questions spanning genetics, cell biology, ecology, and evolution for accuracy, reasoning quality, and completeness

 * Write reference-standard solutions with correct biological reasoning and terminology with correct established biological principles and experimental methodology and clear explanations that AI models learn from

 * Identify factual errors, misapplied biological concepts, or flawed experimental reasoning in AI-produced content, tagging the specific error category

 * Compare and rank multiple AI responses to the same problem, explaining which best reflects scientific accuracy and clarity

 * Test whether AI systems handle ambiguous or multi-concept biology questions correctly

 * Create realistic synthetic case studies spanning genetics, ecology, and molecular biology used to train and evaluate models

 * Contribute to rubric design — defining scoring criteria such as accuracy, scientific rigor, and clarity — used to benchmark AI performance at scale

 * Complete asynchronous task batches independently — no scheduled calls or fixed hours required

Key Qualifications

 * Master’s degree or PhD in Biology or a related life-science field (or equivalent recognized qualification); relevant experience is a plus — postgraduate and doctoral graduates welcome

 * Strong grounding in genetics, cell biology, ecology, or evolutionary biology

 * Research or teaching experience involving biological concepts and experimental design

 * Sharp eye for subtle factual, logical, or methodological error — can detect and explain flawed reasoning in plain English

 * Self-directed, detail-oriented, and comfortable delivering quality work asynchronously

Nice to Have

 * Published research or graduate teaching experience in a biological subfield

 * Proficiency with bioinformatics tools (BLAST, R/Bioconductor) or phylogenetics software

 * Hands-on lab experience with PCR, CRISPR, or other molecular biology techniques

 * Prior experience in content review, QA, or AI/ML data annotation projects

Why Chegg

 * Fully remote and flexible — no fixed schedule

 * Real-world challenges with direct impact on AI accuracy and safety

 * Pathway to ongoing projects for high-quality contributors

title: 【長期インターン】ソフトウェアエンジニア
description:
コーポレートミッション

エンターテインメントとECの融合で、人類を夢中にさせる。

私たちは、エンターテインメントとECを融合し、商品を購入する時間そのものが楽しみになるような体験を提供しています。

世の中にモノやサービスがあふれる一方で、人々を夢中にさせる新しい体験は、まだ十分に生み出されていないと考えています。

そこで私たちは、エンターテインメントとECの境界で「開ける楽しみ」を提供し、長く愛される産業をつくることを目指しています。

会社概要

トラストハブは、オンラインでトレーディングカードのオリジナルパック（オリパ）を購入できるサービス「クローブオリパ」を提供するスタートアップ企業です。2026年時点で登録ユーザー数100万人を突破し、国内有数のBtoCエンターテインメントサービスへと成長しています。

※「オリパ」: トレーディングカード（トレカ）を運営側が独自に組み合わせて販売するパック商品。レアカードが当たる体験性とコレクション性を兼ね備えた、トレカ業界で近年急成長しているフォーマット。

インターンの概要

本インターンでは、実際にトラストハブのサービス開発に取り組んでいただきます。開発したものが実際にリリースされ、ユーザーに届く、そんなリアルな現場を体験できます。

開発領域や対象サービスは、インターン生の希望に合わせて相談して決めます。

経験豊富なメンターによる徹底サポート！

LINE、DeNAなどメガベンチャー出身者も含む事業開発を牽引してきたメンバーが専属メンターとしてつき、ウェブ開発に関するアドバイスやコードレビューを丁寧に行います。 メンターの思考を間近で学び、短期間でサービス開発に必要な力を身につけることができます。

これまでのインターン生の開発内容

2023年度


 * 新規サービスのインフラ設定(terraform)
 * 新規サービスの決済・ポイント機能の設計・開発
 * 新規ネイティブアプリの開発
 * オリパガチャサービスのラストワン機能
 * 仮想レンダリングを使用した商品表示の高速化
 * EメールSaaSを導入したメール送信機能の実装
 * 店舗買取の業務効率の向上
   
   

2024年度


 * ネイティブアプリで会員証QRコード機能の作成
 * ユーザーへのメッセージ一斉送信機能
 * 店舗内検索システムの設計・実装
 * 新規ECサービスと在庫管理システムの連携
   
   

2025年度


 * お知らせ機能の設計・実装 Cloud task の導入
 * 非会員向けデモ体験ガチャ機能の実装
 * 通知の多言語化対応
 * オリパトップページのチューニング
 * ガチャイベントのログ設計
 * トップバナーの実装 ネイティブでのお知らせページの実装
 * 参考相場価格の表示
 * 友達紹介機能の設計、実装
 * オリパの多様性と離脱率の分析
 * 新規ユーザーアンケート施策
 * 新規ユーザーに対するアンケート内容の提案
 * アンケートを実施した場合に、ユーザーに適用するオリパの並び替えの実装
   
   

使用技術

title: Software Engineer Intern

title: Decision Scientist Intern
description:
1. About The India Prosperity Initiative (TIPI)

The India Prosperity Initiative (TIPI) is an objective and non-partisan initiative committed to advancing pervasive prosperity across Indian society. TIPI views prosperity as extending beyond material abundance to encompass the resources, opportunities, capabilities, and societal conditions that enable individuals and communities to realise their potential.




TIPI seeks to deepen the understanding of prosperity in India through rigorous, multidisciplinary, and evidence-based research, using data and insights from diverse sources. It emphasises intellectual rigour, audacity of ideas and methods, collaboration, and trust.




The Initiative aims to generate actionable insights, evaluate solutions, and translate evidence into meaningful action on issues shaping India’s long-term prosperity.




2. About the Role

You will join The India Prosperity Initiative as a Decision Scientist Intern, supporting research and analytical projects through data analysis, statistical modelling, visualisation, and data management. The role will involve working across the data lifecycle, from identifying and preparing relevant datasets to analysing data and translating findings into clear, actionable insights. You will work closely with project teams to support evidence-based research and contribute to high-quality analytical outputs across initiatives.




● Data Analysis, Statistical Modelling, and Predictive Analytics:

You will work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, relationships, and insights using statistical and machine learning techniques. You will support the development of analytical models, performance metrics, benchmarks, and predictive frameworks, while exploring emerging approaches in data science and statistical analysis.

● Data Preparation, Cleaning, and Validation:

You will support the preparation of raw datasets into analysis-ready formats through systematic data cleaning, transformation, harmonisation, and organisation. You will conduct data quality checks to identify inconsistencies, missing values, errors, and anomalies and ensure the reliability of analytical outputs.

● Data Visualisation and Dashboards:

You will develop charts, visualisations, and dashboards to communicate complex analytical findings clearly and effectively. You will work with tools such as Python, R, Excel, Tableau, and Power BI to present data and analytical results in an accessible manner.

● Economic and Socio-Economic Data Analysis:

You will work with economic, demographic, social, and other datasets to support research on issues relevant to India’s development and prosperity. This will involve understanding key indicators, identifying credible data sources, analysing multi-year and cross-regional datasets, and interpreting findings in their broader context.

● Data Tools and Database Management:

You will use tools such as Python, R, MS Excel / Google Sheets, and SQL for data analysis and management. You will support the retrieval, organisation, updating, and analysis of datasets from multiple sources. Familiarity with databases and structured data systems will be an advantage.

● Research Support and Documentation:

You will support project teams in developing analytical frameworks, conducting quantitative analysis, and preparing research outputs. You will maintain clear documentation of datasets, methodologies, analytical approaches, and sources to support transparency and reproducibility.

● Collaboration and Learning:

You will work closely with researchers and project teams to understand analytical requirements, communicate findings, and contribute to project deliverables. The role will provide an opportunity to apply data science skills to real-world challenges affecting India’s development while building an understanding of how quantitative evidence can inform better decisions.

This role is well-suited for a student or early-career candidate with a strong interest in data science, statistics, and applied research. It is ideal for individuals who enjoy working with data and are motivated to apply analytical skills to real-world challenges that contribute to India’s long-term prosperity and development.




3. Role Benefits

● Competitive stipend aligned with industry standards.

● Reimbursements in line with organisational travel policies and applicable norms, where relevant. ● Hands-on experience working with real-world datasets and applied data science projects.

● Exposure to researchers, experts, policymakers, and institutional stakeholders.

● Opportunity to apply statistical and analytical methods to projects relevant to India’s development and prosperity.

● Mentorship and practical experience in data analysis, modelling, visualisation, and research.

● Opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects with potential for real-world application.




4. Eligibility Criteria

● Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Econometrics, Computer Science, or another quantitative discipline.

● Strong academic exposure to statistics, quantitative methods, or data analysis.

● Familiarity with analysing and working with structured datasets using statistical or data science methods.

● Working knowledge of Python or R; familiarity with SQL will be an advantage.

● Familiarity with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Python/R visualisation libraries will be an advantage.

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex problems systematically.

● Strong attention to detail and ability to communicate analytical findings clearly.

● Interest in India’s development, socio-economic issues, research, and data-driven decision-making. Exposure to public policy or socio-economic research through academic or project work will be an advantage.




5. Role location

This is a full-time, in-office internship based in Gurugram, Haryana. The role may involve travel for project activities, institutional engagements, meetings, and other initiatives as required.




6. Duration:

January,2027- June,2027.

title: Incident Commander, Detection & Response - APAC
description:
About The Team

Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at OpenAI. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture.

About The Role

As an Incident Commander on Detection & Response, you’ll lead the response to complex security incidents affecting OpenAI’s intellectual property, customer data, and infrastructure. You’ll establish response priorities, coordinate technical work streams, drive containment and recovery decisions within agreed authority, and keep stakeholders informed as facts evolve. You’ll work with security and infrastructure teams across endpoints, identity, cloud, and compute environments, maintaining clear ownership and effective handoffs across time zones. Detection engineering knowledge is a supporting requirement: you’ll use telemetry and detection logic to assess evidence, identify visibility gaps, and guide improvements that make incident response more effective.

In This Role, You Will


 * Run incident command from initial assessment through containment, recovery, and closure, establishing severity, scope, response objectives, and escalation needs.
 * Assign work stream owners and coordinate investigation, containment, and recovery in parallel. Maintain a decision log and distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions.
 * Drive timely containment and recovery decisions with the appropriate owners, weighing security risk, evidence preservation, and operational impact within agreed decision rights.
 * Communicate incident status, impact, uncertainty, actions underway, and the next update to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
 * Manage cross-time-zone handoffs with explicit command ownership, current status, outstanding risks, pending decisions, and next actions.
 * Improve response readiness through exercises, playbooks, and post-incident reviews; track agreed corrective actions with their owners.
 * Partner with detection engineers to evaluate telemetry and detection quality, close incident-related visibility gaps, and prioritize practical response automation.
   
   

You Might Thrive In This Role If You


 * Have personally led complex security incidents as incident commander or an equivalent response lead, with clear examples of decisions, delegation, escalation, and outcomes.
 * Make sound decisions with incomplete information and revise them as evidence changes, balancing containment urgency with operational impact.
 * Coordinate responders across teams and time zones, resolve conflicting priorities, and maintain clear ownership during handoffs.
 * Communicate calmly and precisely under pressure, including concise stakeholder updates and explicit statements of uncertainty.
 * Have the security and infrastructure fundamentals to challenge investigation findings and assess containment and recovery options.
 * Understand detection engineering, including telemetry coverage, detection logic, false positives and false negatives, and validation. Can query and interpret evidence to support response decisions.
 * Turn incident lessons into practical improvements to readiness, playbooks, detection coverage, and response tooling.

title: AI测试工程师
description:
【关于我们】

我们是一家业务覆盖全球的数字资产与金融科技平台，团队分布在亚太多个国家和地区。

工作地点：亚太地区，全远程办公；全职。




负责 AI Agent 及相关 AI 应用的质量保障，建立覆盖业务正确性、任务执行效果、模型输出质量和服务性能的测试与评测能力。




【岗位职责】

1. 负责 AI Agent 及其承载业务的全流程测试，参与需求与技术方案评审，制定测试方案和验收标准，验证业务规则、接口交互、数据一致性和最终业务结果。

2. 围绕意图理解、任务规划、工具调用、多轮对话、上下文与记忆、RAG 等环节设计场景，覆盖正常、边界、异常、中断及恢复流程，保障端到端任务执行质量。

3. 建设和维护评测集、评分规则与质量基线，从准确性、完整性、相关性、一致性、事实可靠性及任务完成度等维度开展评测，输出版本对比和质量结论。

4. 开发并维护自动化测试与评测脚本，实现样本批量运行、结果校验、指标统计和持续回归，保障模型、Prompt、工具与工作流变更后的产品质量。

5. 开展性能与稳定性测试，关注响应时延、任务耗时、并发处理、失败率和资源消耗；结合产品风险验证权限控制、敏感信息保护及异常工具行为。

6. 结合日志、调用链、执行轨迹和线上反馈分析失败案例，推动产品、算法与研发团队修复问题，沉淀测试资产并持续优化质量标准。




【岗位要求】

1. 具备扎实的软件测试理论和实践能力，能够独立完成需求分析、场景设计、接口及功能测试、缺陷定位和版本质量评估。

2. 理解大模型的基本工作原理与能力边界，了解 Transformer、Token、上下文窗口和采样参数等概念，认识幻觉、非确定性、上下文丢失等常见质量问题。

3. 了解 AI Agent 的核心知识体系，包括任务规划、工具调用、工作流、多轮交互、状态与记忆，以及 RAG 等机制；能够结合执行链路识别测试重点。

4. 掌握大模型及 AI 应用的基础测试评测方法，能够构建代表性样本、定义评分标准，结合规则校验、人工评审与模型辅助评判分析输出质量和任务结果。

5. 熟练掌握 Python、Java、Go 或 TypeScript 中至少一门语言，能够独立编写自动化测试或评测脚本，处理 API、日志与结构化数据；具备基础性能测试和数据分析能力。

6. 对 AI 保持持续兴趣与主动学习习惯，能够通过实际项目、实验或评测案例展示探索成果；逻辑清晰，具备问题分析、沟通协作和推动问题闭环的能力。




【加分项】

- 有 AI Agent、RAG 或 LLM 应用测试落地经验；使用过评测工具或搭建过评测回归流程；了解一种 Agent 开发框架；有业务领域、性能稳定性、客户端或多模态专项经验；能有效使用 AI 编程工具并核验产出。




【语言要求】

中文为主要工作语言，需具备流利的中文沟通与书面表达能力；具备英文工作能力者优先。




【我们提供】

全远程办公、有竞争力的薪酬、全球化的团队与业务视野。

title: UN Women National Consultant - Documentation and Research, New Delhi, India
description:
Job Description


 * Background
   
   
   

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls, the empowerment of women, and the achievement of gender equality. UN Women supports Member States and partners in advancing women’s leadership and participation, ending violence against women, promoting women’s economic empowerment, and integrating gender equality into national planning, budgeting, and development processes.

In India, UN Women works with government institutions, civil society organisations, development partners, and other stakeholders to advance gender equality and women’s empowerment. A key area of its work is Gender-Responsive Budgeting (GRB), which seeks to ensure that policies, plans, public expenditure, and resource allocation respond effectively to the different needs, priorities, and realities of women and men. Through its GRB programme, UN Women India supports efforts to strengthen institutional capacities, improve gender analysis in planning and budgeting, promote evidence-based decision-making, and enhance accountability for gender equality commitments. This work includes engagement with relevant Union Ministries and State Governments, strengthening technical capacities and institutional mechanisms, and facilitating dialogue among stakeholders to promote the effective integration of gender perspectives into public financial management.

As part of these efforts, UN Women India facilitates multi-stakeholder engagement and advocacy to strengthen gender-responsive public financing, including through the Annual Feminist Pre-Budget Consultation. The consultation provides a platform for civil society organisations, feminist economists, researchers, practitioners, development partners, and other relevant stakeholders to deliberate on emerging budgetary priorities and fiscal policies from a gender equality perspective. It seeks to bring evidence, field-level experiences, and feminist perspectives into discussions on the Union Budget, identify gaps in resource allocation and implementation, and generate actionable recommendations for more equitable and inclusive public expenditure. The consultation also creates opportunities to consolidate stakeholder inputs, strengthen collective advocacy, and communicate key recommendations to relevant policymakers and other decision-makers in the budget process.

In this context, UN Women India envisages engaging a consultant to support the planning, coordination, and documentation of the Annual Feminist Pre-Budget Consultation. The consultancy will contribute to the effective organisation of the consultation, including the preparation of the concept note and agenda, stakeholder and speaker coordination, participant management, documentation of deliberations, consolidation of key recommendations, and development of communication materials. The assignment will help ensure that the consultation’s discussions and outcomes are systematically captured and disseminated to inform ongoing advocacy and engagement on gender-responsive budgeting and public financing for gender equality in India.

Within this context, UN Women Inda seeks the services of consultant to coordinate the organizing of a feminist pre-budget consultation. The Consultant will work under the guidance and supervision of the Coordinator, Gender Responsive Budgeting, UN Women India Office.


 * Roles and Responsibilities
   
   
   

Under the guidance of UN Women, India and in close coordination with relevant stakeholders, the Consultant will be responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, communication, and documentation of the Feminist Pre-Budget Consultation. The responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:


 * Stakeholder Coordination
 * Organize and facilitate planning meetings with concerned stakeholders.
 * Ensure timely communication, circulation of meeting materials, and follow-up on agreed action points.
 * Participant Management
 * Manage the registration process for all participants.
 * Maintain updated participant records, including contact details, travel requirements, and confirmations.
 * Agenda and Concept Note
 * Draft the Concept Note and Agenda based on inputs from UN Women and key partners.
 * Revise and finalize documents in consultation with stakeholders.
 * Invitations and Speaker Engagement
 * Prepare and issue invitations to speakers, panelists, and participants.
 * Follow up on confirmations, bios, and session requirements.
 * Session Documentation and Event Reporting
 * Coordinate notetaking and documentation of all Consultation sessions.
 * Compile and prepare the complete event report, including participant list and key recommendations.
 * Communications & Social Media Outreach
 * Develop a social media and communications outreach plan with relevant teams.
 * Support at least 10 social media posts to amplify visibility of the Consultation.
 * Knowledge Sharing
 * Share the final list of recommendations and the event report with all participants and relevant stakeholders.

 * Deliverables
 * Deliverable 1: Concept Note and Agenda for the Feminist Pre-Budget Consultation, finalized in consultation with UN Women and relevant stakeholders.
    * Timeline: November 15
    * Payment: 20%

 * Deliverable 2: Comprehensive Event Report, including session summaries, participant list, and consolidated key recommendations.
    * Timeline: November 27
    * Payment: 40%

 * Deliverable 3: At least 10 social media posts drafted and/or coordinated for posting to enhance the visibility of the Consultation.
    * Timeline: November 28
    * Payment: 20%

 * Deliverable 4: Complete set of documentation files, meeting notes, and consolidated records, including dissemination of the final recommendations and event report to relevant stakeholders.
    * Timeline: December 2
    * Payment: 20%
      
      
      

Total payment: 100%

(Please note that payment will be processed upon completion of deliverables as per timeline and upon submission of requisite payment documents.)


 * Evaluation Criteria of submissions
 * Understanding of the assignment and its objectives - 33%
 * Coordination, organisational, and stakeholder management skills - 33%
 * Communication skills, problem-solving ability, and capacity to deliver quality outputs within timelines - 34%
 * Total - 100%
   
   
   

Please Note:


 * Travel, if any will be reimbursed by UN Women with prior approval and submission of F-10 form with original ticket stubs, vouchers, etc. as per actuals.
 * For an assignment requiring travel, consultants of 65 years or more require full medical examination and statement of fitness to work to engage in the consultancy.

About The Team

The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.

You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.

This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In This Role, You Will


 * Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
 * Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
 * Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
 * Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
 * Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.

 * Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
 * Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.

 * Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
 * Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.

 * Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.

title: Principal Data Scientist

Applies cutting-edge data science approaches while adhering to project timelines.

Sponsor-dedicated

Working fully embedded within one of our pharmaceutical clients, with the support of Cytel right behind you, you'll be at the heart of our client's innovation. You will be dedicated to one of our global pharmaceutical clients; a company that is driving the next generation of patient treatment, where individuals are empowered to work with autonomy and ownership. This is an exciting time to be a part of this new program.

Position Overview

This position will provide technical expertise in integrating biomedical signal analysis, probabilistic modelling, and scalable data pipelines, ensuring high-quality, reproducible insights from complex biomedical high frequency data, including electrophysiological, AI-based 24/7 video recordings and wearable-derived signals, tabular data, e.g. demographic and genetic, and EHR. Applies cutting-edge data science approaches while adhering to project timelines.

Responsibilities

As a Principal Data Scientist, your responsibilities will include:


 * Identify, access, and integrate diverse data sources, including clinical study data, observational data, and real-world healthcare datasets, ensuring high-quality data extraction and pre-processing.
 * Develop and implement signal processing methods for data curation and feature/pattern extraction from longitudinal data, with particular focus on high frequency data (e.g., electrophysiological and wearable signals), for clinical and research applications.

title: Sensory Scientist
description:
Position Title:Sensory Scientist

Position Type: Regular - Full-Time

Requisition ID: 45150

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

The Sensory Scientist reports to the Sensory UX Innovation Manager, Asia Pacific and South African (APACSA) and is based in Delhi, India.

This role applies sensory and consumer/customer research best practices and methodologies, to provide guidance and insights to McCain’s regional and local Product Development teams throughout the stage gate process.

This position is a key member of a Asia Pacific and South African (APACSA) regional Sensory UX team and provides direction and training to various stakeholders on all sensory aspects of McCain’s products. Sensory Scientist partners with cross-functional teams to integrate sensory practices and testing, where appropriate, throughout the product development process.

The role is responsible for using and creating sensory Consumer/customer and analytical methods to guide product development, enable successful innovation launches and guide renovation efforts. The Sensory Scientist designs and leads testing plans with scientific rigor, issues reports and creates actionable recommendations to stakeholders.

The Sensory Scientist collaborates with R&D, Marketing, Consumer Insights, Operations, and other internal and external partners on new products, processes, quality improvements and cost savings to drive McCain’s profitable growth.

As part of the Global Sensory and User Experience team, the Sensory Scientist also works with internal team members to expand McCain’s global sensory capabilities. This includes the optimization and standardization of sensory tools and the development of new or hybrid methods. It also includes developing new training materials, assessing and onboarding new vendors, identifying and closing gaps the company has in regard to its sensory needs, and contributing to investigations regarding the linkage between sensory methods or attribute intensities to instrumental test methods.

The position executes and reports sensory and consumer/customer research studies. As such, the Sensory Scientist builds and maintains strong relationships with core vendors, supervises the application of best scientific practices by such vendors and manages test costs and timelines.

This position is based in the McCain HO. Ad hoc travel to regional plants and research venues (including Research Agency sites, Universities etc) may be required (eg for product tastings/review and other R&D focused activities as required). McCain will reimburse travel costs for such work-related travel

What You’ll Be Doing.


 * Partners with Consumer Insights, Research and Development, Marketing, Packaging, Supply Chain, and other business and product teams to guide the optimization of innovation products, product improvements, and define product quality as part of building consumer led specifications.
 * Drives projects through appropriate product and packaging consumer/customer and sensory learning plans from optimization to confirmatory testing, inclusive of building foundational product knowledge, protecting product quality, and enhancing consumer/customer understanding.
 * Facilitates consumer/customer interactions to grow consumer/customer empathy. Examples of this include meetings with Customers to review and define product development briefs and sensory review of stimulus, as well as leveraging any consumer/customer research being conducted by Sensory UX or Consumer Insights, to bring exposure of the internal McCain R&D team to the consumer.
 * Facilitates the running of robust, objective, and fit for purpose, round table/cook ups:

 * With relevant McCain R&D/Technical Operations/Quality/Commercial team members, to make the right decisions at the right time regards prototypes, market samples etc, and/or to educate and immerse the team in product/category insight.
 * The Sensory Scientist will lead moderation of such sessions, where it is appropriate. The Developer will also moderate for routine, lower risk panels.
 * The set up is carried out by the R&D Product/Pack Developer, under guidance from the Sensory Scientist
 * Courageously champions product design and product quality as the sensory representative on the Research & Development and business teams.
 * Further strengthens best sensory practices within the Research & Development teams and provoke a ‘sensory’ and ‘experimental’ mindset.
 * Applies design of experiments (DoE) to sensory and consumer/customer testing.
 * Translates data to insights through synthesis of qualitative consumer/customer learning and interpretation of statistical analyses of quantitative sensory and consumer/customer data.
 * Communicates key findings in a relevant and easy to understand manner and guide business teams to next steps in the product development process.
 * Develops and fosters strong relationships with key sensory and consumer testing vendors (including research agencies, Universities etc) to ensure flawless execution of tests and appropriate pricing.
 * Partners with the business to activate Product Stewardship programs. These focus on measuring and understanding the competitive space (internally or using external Trained Panel and consumer/customer research) and giving actionable guidance, that may lead to renovation activities.
 * Works with The Sensory UX Innovation Manager, APACSA, to forward the Sensory UX agenda through the region. There may be occasions where participation in the broader McCain Sensory and UX team and/or R&D team is required eg team meetings, methodology review, relevant training sessions etc.
   
   

What You’ll Need To Be Successful.


 * Bachelor’s degree in Sensory Science, Food Science, Statistics, Psychology, or a related field.
 * Master’s degree with emphasis in Sensory Science preferred.
 * Minimum 4 years of sensory science and consumer research experience across multiple research methodologies.
 * Experience planning and executing sensory and consumer research in collaboration with R&D and Consumer Insights teams.
 * Strong understanding of sensory evaluation techniques, including discrimination testing, descriptive analysis, internal panel management, and consumer research methodologies.
 * Working knowledge of applied statistics, Design of Experiments (DoE), and multivariate analysis techniques.
 * Excellent communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills.
 * Ability to manage multiple projects, synthesize complex data into actionable insights, and communicate findings effectively to diverse audiences.
 * Experience managing external vendors and research partners is preferred.
 * Knowledge of food chemistry, biochemistry, and statistics is desirable.
 * Scientific curiosity and a strong commitment to experimentation, innovation, and continuous learning.
   
   

About The Team.

This role is part of the APACSA Sensory UX team and reports to the Sensory UX Innovation Manager, APACSA. The Sensory Scientist works closely with regional and global Sensory UX colleagues as well as cross-functional partners across R&D, Consumer Insights, Marketing, Operations, Packaging, and Commercial teams. The position plays an important role in strengthening McCain’s sensory capabilities and fostering a consumer-led innovation culture across the region.

Leadership principles.

At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve success. We focus on understanding customer needs, driving innovation, empowering people, and taking ownership to clear obstacles and deliver results.

At McCain, AI and digital capabilities are part of how we work and innovate. We value curiosity toward emerging technologies and the thoughtful, responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve outcomes as part of our future-ready culture.

The McCain Experience.

Our winning culture is rooted in authenticity and trust, empowering us to bring out the best in one another. Here, you’ll find opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. title: AI Engineer – Physical AI & Digital Twin Systems
description:
Position Summary:

Siemens Energy Gas Services (GS) seeks an AI Engineer to build production-grade Physical AI and Digital Twin systems for advanced manufacturing. The role centers on robot perception, reasoning, control, simulation, and deployment across cloud, edge, and real-world operations.

You will design, train, evaluate, and deploy AI models that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous robotic workflows across simulation and physical environments, owning the lifecycle from data and experimentation to inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Working at the intersection of robotics, industrial software, and AI, you will partner with product, controls, robotics, and domain teams to deliver reliable, observable, and scalable systems that improve autonomy, safety, and productivity.

How You’ll Make an Impact (key responsibilities of role)


 * Build and operate data and training pipelines for collection, labeling, augmentation, versioning, and evaluation across simulation and real-world datasets.
 * Develop and deploy AI models for robot perception, reasoning, and action, including computer vision, multimodal models, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems.
 * Apply sim-to-real methods using synthetic data, domain randomization, imitation learning, transfer learning, and benchmark-driven validation.
 * Integrate models with Digital Twin and robotics platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, robot middleware, and orchestration services.
 * Deploy scalable inference and control services on cloud and edge environments using containers, Kubernetes, APIs, and event-driven workflows.
 * Establish observability for model and system performance, including experiment tracking, evaluation, drift detection, telemetry, and safe rollback mechanisms.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate industrial use cases into production-ready AI capabilities with measurable reliability and productivity impact.
   
   

What You Bring (required Qualification And Skill Sets)


 * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
 * 2–5 years of experience building, training, evaluating, and deploying AI/ML systems in production.
 * Strong Python engineering skills, including packaging, testing, APIs, and performance-oriented development; C++ is a plus for robotics integration.
 * Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and with computer vision or multimodal model development.
 * Experience with robotic AI concepts such as perception, planning support, control integration, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or Vision-Language-Action models.
 * Practical knowledge of MLOps and deployment, including experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, containers, and cloud or edge inference.
 * Experience with simulation and Digital Twin workflows, including sim-to-real validation and evaluation using telemetry, sensor, and vision data.
 * Ability to define metrics, benchmarks, and safety-minded validation processes for reliable deployment in industrial environments.
   
   

Good-to-Have Qualifications


 * Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, or similar robotics simulation platforms.
 * Familiarity with world models, synthetic data generation, diffusion policy methods, or foundation-model-based robotics workflows.
 * Exposure to edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson and to latency-, compute-, or power-constrained deployment.
 * Understanding robot middleware, telemetry pipelines, and distributed or real-time robotic system architectures.
 * Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, or other safety-critical operational environments.
   
   

Key Attributes


 * Strong problem solving mindset and ability to work with team members from different domains.
 * Excellent communication skills and willingness to support others across the team.
 * Hands‑on engineering mindset with focus on practical development & deployment.
 * Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to non‑experts.
 * High ownership and accountability.
 * Comfortable working across R&D, engineering, and service organizations.

title: Researcher
description:
We are seeking a talented and analytically minded Specialist-Research & Market Intelligence to support our talent sourcing, recruitment strategy, and talent marketplace initiatives. This role focuses on market intelligence, competitive analysis, candidate behavior research, and talent ecosystem dynamics that inform our recruitment strategy, platform positioning, and talent marketplace expansion. You'll combine quantitative and qualitative research methodologies to deliver actionable insights that drive hiring effectiveness, candidate quality, and marketplace growth across geographies and verticals.




Primary Responsibilities

Talent Marketplace & Recruitment Technology Competitive Analysis

 * Conduct competitive landscape analysis of talent sourcing platforms.
 * Track and analyze pricing models, feature releases, and market positioning of competing talent marketplaces
 * Research emerging talent marketplace players, funding rounds, M&A activity, and market consolidation patterns
 * Identify white spaces in the talent marketplace ecosystem (underserved geographies, verticals, candidate segments)

Recruitment Strategy & Talent Sourcing Research

 * Research and document emerging trends in talent sourcing strategies across industries and geographies
 * Study talent acquisition best practices, hiring funnel optimization, and recruitment process automation
 * Monitor employer branding strategies, EVP (Employer Value Proposition) positioning, and talent attraction trends
 * Research skills gap analysis, high-demand talent segments, and emerging skill requirements

Candidate Behavior & Demographic Research

 * Analyze candidate preferences, job search behaviors, and platform engagement patterns
 * Research demographic shifts in job seeking (age cohorts, geographic origins, education backgrounds)
 * Research underrepresented talent pools and barriers to entry for diverse candidate segments
 * Track candidate sentiment and satisfaction with recruitment experiences through surveys and social listening

Talent Marketplace Performance Analytics

 * Analyze marketplace metrics: candidate registrations, profile completion rates, employer adoption, placement rates
 * Research talent pool quality, matching effectiveness, and placement success rates by geography and industry
 * Create dashboards and KPIs tracking marketplace health, growth, and user engagement
 * Conduct funnel analysis: sourcing → engagement → application → hire → retention
 * Benchmark our marketplace performance against competitors and industry standards
 * Identify drop-off points and optimization opportunities in recruitment workflows

Data Collection & Analysis

 * Design and deploy surveys to candidates, employers, university partners, and recruitment professionals
 * Extract and analyze large datasets from talent marketplace platforms, ATS systems, and industry databases
 * Create visualizations and infographics presenting talent market insights and recruitment trends
 * Use tools like Excel, Python, SQL for data manipulation and statistical analysis

Research Deliverables & Strategic Insights

 * Author talent marketplace research reports, market sizing studies, and competitive analyses
 * Prepare executive summaries and board-ready presentations on talent acquisition trends
 * Develop research briefs for product, marketing, and partnership teams
 * Create quarterly/annual talent market reports by geography, industry vertical, and skill category
 * Contribute to thought leadership: industry publications, webinars, conference presentations
 * Provide recommendations for marketplace feature priorities and expansion opportunities

Ongoing Talent Market Monitoring

 * Monitor talent marketplace industry publications, recruitment technology blogs, and HR research platforms
 * Subscribe to talent acquisition intelligence services
 * Build and maintain centralized talent market knowledge base with competitive intelligence
 * Flag emerging opportunities and market threats for leadership review
 * Track emerging talent marketplace players, new geographies, and expanding use cases

title: Data Analyst
description:
About The Company

Who are we?

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.

Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.

From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

The Role

The Customer Experience (CX) charter at Myntra is dedicated to removing friction from the user journey—from app launch to post-delivery support. As a Data Analyst for the CX team, you will be the analytical engine driving our understanding of customer behavior, pain points, and satisfaction metrics. You will translate complex datasets into clear, actionable strategies that directly influence product roadmaps and business operations.

Key Responsibilities


 * Data Analytics and Insights: Dive deep into customer interaction data (NPS, CSAT, app drop-offs, and support tickets) to identify root causes of customer friction. Translate raw data into actionable insights that guide CX improvements.
 * Predictive Trend Analysis: Build models to forecast customer behavior, return rates, and seasonal ticket volumes. Anticipate CX challenges before they occur to help operations and product teams stay ahead of the curve.
 * Visual Intelligence: Design and maintain intuitive, high-impact dashboards (via Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker) that track core CX metrics. Make complex data easily consumable for leadership and cross-functional teams.
 * Market Intelligence: Monitor industry benchmarks and competitor CX strategies. Identify gaps and opportunities to ensure Myntra remains the gold standard for e-commerce customer experience in India.
 * Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary data partner for CX leaders. Effectively communicate findings, influence strategic decisions, and align analytical outputs with operational realities.
 * Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Support teams to deploy data-backed solutions and track the efficacy of new feature rollouts.
   
   

Required Skills & Qualifications

We Are Looking For a Candidate Who Demonstrates a Strong Baseline (minimum 2 Years Of Applied Experience Or a Solid Level 2 Proficiency) Across The Following Core Competencies


 * Data Analytics and Insights (2): Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and advanced Excel. Strong ability to extract, clean, and interpret large datasets to solve ambiguous problems.
 * Visual Intelligence (2): Hands-on experience with BI tools. Ability to design dashboards that tell a compelling story rather than just displaying numbers.
 * Predictive Trend Analysis (2): Experience working with statistical methods, forecasting, and basic machine learning concepts to predict customer trends.
 * Market Intelligence (2): Familiarity with e-commerce market dynamics, consumer behavior research, and competitive benchmarking.
 * Business Acumen (2): Strong understanding of how CX metrics (like retention and lifetime value) directly impact the bottom line. Ability to balance customer delight with business profitability.
 * Stakeholder Management (2) & Collaboration (2): Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proven ability to translate technical findings for non-technical audiences and drive alignment across diverse teams.
   
   

Required Skills

data analytics, visual intelligence, market intelligence

title: Senior R&D Associate, Microbiology
description:

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Research & Development

We do the right thing, always, by ensuring we act with responsibility and integrity, by complying with regulatory legislation across the globe, whilst ensuring our products are safe for our consumers and are to the highest quality.

You will also have access to our Research and Development Academy, designed to develop our team and allow you to grow in our great organisation.

You will work with formulation scientists to develop technical strategies to support short-term and long-term microbiological claims for Germ Protection R&D global projects. You will liaise with external laboratories and key opinion leaders in a professional and productive manner to ensure relationship and high quality of work/expertise. You will lead, inspire and develop junior team members to deliver their projects

 * Technical problem solving and troubleshooting when required, ensuring issues are addressed without delay to projects.
 * Conduct testing to evaluate the antimicrobial efficacy of prototype formulations, finished products and ingredients as well as competitor products.
 * Analyze, review results and prepare technical reports on progress/ completion of testing for the category.
 * Contribute towards continuous improvement of R&D laboratory procedures and best practices
 * Recommend improvements to existing techniques, processes, systems or programs
 * Ensure compliance to quality standards by following documented procedures & good documentation practices.
 * Be aware, accountable for safety, health & environment in workplace all time to ensure safe work environment for self and colleagues.
   
   

The experience we're looking for

Experience of Micro efficacy methodologies like EN, ASTM, ISO, etc. used to support claims on antimicrobial personal care and surface care products.

The skills for success

Task Execution Under Pressure, Makes strategic Business Decisions, Business accumen, Commercial Awareness, Objective Setting, Accountability, Consumer Insight, Creative Direction, R&D, Change Leadership, Product Lifecycle Management, Business Partnership, Collaboration and partnership building, Relationship Management, Adapt to changes in technological development plans, Ability to challenge the status quo and propose improvement, Innovation Processes, Digital transformation for R&D, Quality and Manufacturing.

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

Job Description – AI Engineer Intern (Agentic AI)

Role: AI Engineer Intern – Agentic AI & LLM Engineering

Department: AI Engineering

Location: Bengaluru

Employment Type: Internship

About The Role

We are looking for a technically strong and passionate AI Engineer Intern with hands-on experience building Agentic AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).

The ideal candidate should have practical exposure to DeepAgents, LangGraph, Agent Harness development, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI Observability, and LLM Evaluations (Evals) through academic projects, personal projects, internships, or open-source contributions.

You will work on designing, developing, evaluating, and deploying AI agents capable of performing complex, multi-step business workflows by interacting with tools, APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.

We are looking for candidates who go beyond basic chatbot development and are interested in building reliable, tool-enabled, and measurable AI applications.

Key Responsibilities


 * Agentic AI & Agent Harness Development
 * Design and develop AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, and DeepAgents.
 * Build and customize agent harnesses to support planning, tool execution, context management, and multi-step workflows.
 * Implement agent middleware for tool retries, error handling, human-in-the-loop approvals, and context management.
 * Work with agent memory, state management, checkpointing, and persistent execution.
 * Develop reusable tools, sub-agents, and agent orchestration workflows.
 * Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Tool Integration
 * Develop and integrate MCP servers and clients to connect AI agents with external systems.
 * Build reusable tools for interacting with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.
 * Implement structured tool calling, input validation, error handling, and secure tool execution.
 * Understand tool discovery, tool permissions, and integration patterns.
 * AI Observability & Monitoring
 * Implement end-to-end tracing and monitoring for LLM and agent-based applications.
 * Work with observability frameworks such as MLflow, LangSmith, Langfuse, or OpenTelemetry.
 * Capture and analyze agent execution traces, tool calls, model responses, token consumption, latency, and failures.
 * Debug agent execution paths and identify reliability and performance issues.
 * Support monitoring and optimization of AI application quality and inference costs.
 * LLM Evaluations (Evals) & Reliability
 * Design and implement evaluation frameworks for AI agents and LLM applications.
 * Create evaluation datasets with ground-truth examples and expected outputs.
 * Implement evaluations for tool selection, tool execution, structured outputs, and end-to-end agent decisions.
 * Measure correctness, precision, recall, consistency, hallucinations, and task completion.
 * Develop automated regression tests to evaluate changes in prompts, models, and agent workflows.
 * Experiment with LLM-as-a-Judge and human feedback mechanisms.
 * Generative AI & Application Development
 * Develop LLM-powered applications using Python and model APIs.
 * Implement prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
 * Build APIs and backend services using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
 * Work with structured and unstructured enterprise data, including documents, emails, PDFs, and databases.
 * Collaborate with engineering teams to develop and deploy AI solutions for real-world business use cases.
   
   

Required Technical Skills


 * Programming: Strong Python fundamentals, OOP, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, and JSON.
 * Agentic AI: Hands-on exposure to LangGraph, DeepAgents, or comparable agent frameworks, including agent orchestration and tool calling.
 * Agent Harness: Understanding of agent execution loops, middleware, tool integration, state management, and error handling.
 * MCP: Understanding of MCP architecture and experience building or integrating MCP servers and tools.
 * Observability: Familiarity with instrumenting and debugging LLM or agent workflows using tracing and monitoring tools.
 * Evals: Understanding of evaluation datasets, correctness metrics, and methods for evaluating LLM and agent outputs.
 * LLMs: Knowledge of prompts, embeddings, structured outputs, function calling, and RAG.
 * Software Engineering: Git, debugging, unit testing, and basic database knowledge.
   
   

Good to Have


 * Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic, or open-source LLMs.
 * Familiarity with MLflow, LangSmith, Langfuse, or OpenTelemetry.
 * Experience with Pydantic, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or vector databases.
 * Knowledge of Docker, cloud deployment, and CI/CD pipelines.
 * Exposure to multi-agent architectures, human-in-the-loop workflows, and persistent agent memory.
 * Familiarity with document intelligence, information extraction, or enterprise workflow automation.
   
   

Educational Qualifications


 * Currently pursuing (in their Final Semester) or recently completed B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
 * Strong programming fundamentals and demonstrated interest in AI engineering.
 * Academic projects, open-source contributions, hackathons, or independent AI projects are an advantage.
   
   

Ideal Candidate

We Are Looking For Someone Who


 * Has explored building AI agents beyond basic prompt-based applications.
 * Understands how agents interact with tools, manage state, and execute workflows.
 * Thinks about AI reliability, evaluations, and observability.
 * Can debug agent workflows and identify opportunities for improvement.
 * Enjoys working on real-world engineering challenges.
 * Is proactive, technically curious, and comfortable exploring rapidly evolving AI technologies.
 * Can explain the architecture, implementation, and technical decisions behind their projects.
 * Our ideal candidate is a hands-on AI builder who can design an agent, connect it to real tools, evaluate its decisions, observe its execution, and continuously improve its reliability.

Role : AI Engineer




What you'll actually do :

 * Take a CxO-level problem from "we should do this" to "it's live, here's the impact", in 1 weeks, not quarters. Operate as engineer, PM, designer, and analyst.
 * The role is whatever the problem needs. Build agents that automate parts of the org's work, yours included.
 * Ship product, internal tools, customer-facing software, agent loops, automations, wherever leverage is highest.
 * Run experiments. Have strong opinions about which models, which tools, and which workflows actually work , and prove them with output.




What we're looking for :

 * Background. 2–6 years of experience. Top engineering or CS school in India or abroad. Or you're currently at one of those schools and have decided dropping out and building is the better trade. Both paths land here.
 * AI-first by default. Not "I use ChatGPT sometimes." Your daily workflow assumes AI is in the loop on every task that can be improved by it. Cursor, Claude Code, custom agents, MCPs, pick your stack and own it.
 * Open-source model fluency. You've stress-tested the lineup, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, and whatever's on the leaderboard this week. You have opinions on which one wins where, what they're bad at, and where the cost / latency / quality frontier sits today.
 * Builder, not talker. Side projects, OSS contributions, internal tools at your last job, a hackathon weapon , something we can look at and say "that's a person who ships."
 * Single-person army energy. Ambiguity, multi-hat, no playbook , energising rather than draining.
 * Taste. You know good design, good UX, good code, and good prompts when you see them. You can articulate why one approach is better than another in a way that holds up under scrutiny.
 * Eval mindset. You don't just "vibe-check" your AI work. You build the smallest possible eval before shipping , and have an opinion about why most AI products fail without one.




What makes you stand out

 * You've fine-tuned a model, even if just for fun.
 * You've built agents that orchestrate other agents, not just single-shot LLM calls.
 * You have a public artifact, GitHub stars, a blog, X posts that engineers quote, a YouTube channel where you build in public.
 * You contribute to open-source AI tooling.
 * You can show evidence of doing the work of five people in a quarter, and explain how.
 * You've shipped a product with paying users, even at small scale.
 * You've helped a startup or team replace a manual process with an agent that now runs on its own.




What the first call looks like

 * This is non-standard, so we'll be transparent up front.
 * The first technical call is one hour, hands-on, and runs entirely off your screen.
 * Come ready to walk us through: Your AI productivity setup. The tools, the agents, the workflows, the hotkeys.
 * We want to see your terminal, your editor, your prompt library, your custom skills. 2 Your token usage history.
 * Yes, actually open the dashboard on the call, we want to see what you actually use, how much, on what.
 * Your three favourite projects. Demo each one, walk us through the architecture, and tell us what was hard.
 * Your learnings. What worked, what didn't, where AI broke down for you, what you do when a model is the wrong tool.




What you'll get

 * Direct line to a CxO from day one.
 * Real ownership, products, businesses, P&L exposure, whatever the mandate requires.
 * A team of one or two, shaped by you.
 * We'll back the hires you want; we'll trust the calls you make.
 * Founder-engineer compensation, not IC-engineer compensation.
 * Freedom to use whatever models, agents, frameworks, and tools work best for the problem in front of you.
 * Working with leaders building Razorpay's next decade, not maintaining the last one

title: Backend Engineer
description:
About ZillOut




ZillOut builds the operating layer behind how India goes out: nightlife, dining and live events, where real money moves every minute.

Clubs, cafés, sundowners and concerts run on one system: POS and ordering, entry and the digital cover, ticketing and reservations. Venues and organizers use it to run tighter operations, stop revenue leaks and understand their guests.




We're hiring a backend engineer to build the platform venues and organizers run on: entry, ticketing, reservations, ordering, and payments. Strong fundamentals matter more than years of experience, and frontend skills are a plus.




Role: Backend Engineer (Java / Spring Boot)

Experience: 0–2 years

Employment: Full-time

Location: Remote




What you'll work on




You'll ship backend features that venue staff, organizers and guests use the same week.




 * Build and maintain REST APIs in Java and Spring Boot for our merchant, partner and customer apps
 * Design PostgreSQL tables and keep queries fast on a busy Friday night
 * Work on money flows (bills, taxes, discounts, online payments and refunds), where every rupee has to add up
 * Build integrations: WhatsApp messaging, payment gateways, delivery platforms and thermal printers for KOTs and bills
 * Push live order updates over WebSockets and run background work through message queues
 * Debug production issues from logs and monitoring, then ship the fix

What we're looking for




Experience is not a hard filter. A fresher with solid projects or internships is as welcome as someone with 1–2 years in a job.

 * Has built a REST API with Spring Boot (an internship, college or personal project all count)

 * Understands HTTP: methods, status codes, JSON and how login sessions or tokens work
 * Uses Git every day: branches, pull requests and fixing merge conflicts
 * Reads unfamiliar code, debugs step by step and asks when stuck
 * Cares about getting it right: bills and payments are full of edge cases




Good to have




Frontend knowledge is the biggest plus. Engineers here often ship an API and the screen that uses it.




 * React: hooks, fetching data from APIs and forms; TypeScript or a component library like Chakra UI or MUI
 * JPA / Hibernate, Spring Security, JWT
 * Message queues (RabbitMQ or Kafka) and WebSockets
 * Docker, Linux basics, AWS (EC2, RDS, S3)
 * A side project that is live, or anything real people have used
 * An interest in restaurants, nightlife, or events




Why join




 * What you build goes live at real venues within a sprint
 * Small team: you own features end to end, from the table design to the screen
 * Learn backend, frontend, mobile and infra in one place
 * Work directly with the founders and see your work change how venues run

title: AI & LLM Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.

Beeinflusst die Qualität der eigenen Arbeit und der Arbeit anderer im Team.Führt betriebliche/technische Standardaufgaben aus, die in der Regel Anweisungen und Arbeitsabläufen unterliegen.Möglicherweise besteht Spielraum, um die Reihenfolge zu ändern und Aufgaben/Pflichten basierend auf sich ändernden Arbeitssituationen zu erledigen.

Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten

Wenden die Steuerungstheorie und mathematische Modellierung auf Entwurfs- und Steuerungssysteme mit dem gewünschten Verhalten an. Beinhaltet Bedienbarkeit, Festlegen von Grenzen, Zyklusoptimierung, Steuerlogik, steuerungsbezogene Software, Sensoren, Hardware- und Softwarealgorithmen sowie Feedback zur Steuerung der Leistung von Geräten, Subsystemen und Systemen.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
