title: Full-Stack AI-Native Engineer Internship
description:
Babaclick operates at the core of international e-commerce across major global markets, including the UK and US. Our Gurgaon team builds the commercial, operational, and systems infrastructure behind sourcing, pricing, supplier management, catalogue growth, workflow automation, and scalable operational decision-making.




As AI reshapes how modern businesses operate, we're embedding AI-assisted software development, workflow automation, structured data systems, and operational intelligence into every function of the business.




This is a three-month paid internship, offering ₹40,000 per month. You’ll work in person with our team at our Gurugram office for the duration of the internship.




We're hiring software engineers with proven professional experience, solid engineering fundamentals, and real exposure to production environments — engineers who already build, debug, and ship using AI-assisted development as a core part of their workflow, not an experiment.




About the Role:This isn't a role for building technology in isolation. Our engineers work on systems that directly shape how the business operates, scales, and makes decisions. Most projects start with a real business problem, not a predefined technical spec — you'll work with engineering and business teams to understand a workflow, spot bottlenecks, design a solution, implement it, validate it, and keep it reliable in production.




 * You'll contribute across:AI-assisted product development and internal platform engineering
 * Catalogue growth systems and workflow automation
 * API integrations and operational tooling
 * Data quality, structured data systems, and internal dashboards/reporting
 * Debugging production issues and business process optimisation
 * Scalable, AI-enabled operational infrastructure




Projects typically span databases, backend services, APIs, frontend applications, and automation tooling — so we're looking for engineers who understand not just how to build a solution, but why it should be built, what it's solving, and whether it's the right call for the business.

 * Who We're Looking For:Strong candidates typically bring:Experience: 1+ years of professional software engineering experience, ideally at a recognised technology, product, SaaS, fintech, or e-commerce company, contributing to real production systems and existing codebases.
 * Academic background: A strong foundation in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT, or a related discipline — preferably from a Tier 1 or strong Tier 2 institution.
 * Engineering fundamentals: Solid backend, full-stack, or general application development skills, plus a track record of shipping useful software, automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products.
 * Judgement and communication: Strong analytical thinking, high ownership and attention to detail, excellent written/verbal English, comfort in fast-moving environments, and the confidence to question assumptions rather than just execute instructions.




 * This role is not for candidates whose AI experience is limited to experimenting with ChatGPT. You should already be using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar in real engineering work, and be able to:Structure prompts and context that reliably produce high-quality output
 * Read, validate, and improve AI-generated code — catching bad assumptions, edge cases, and weak implementations
 * Debug AI-generated code when it doesn't behave as expected
 * Work within existing codebases, not just isolated personal projects
 * Break down complex problems into structured implementation plans
 * Use AI to move faster without outsourcing technical judgement




You should also be comfortable with standard collaborative workflows — Git/GitHub, branching, pull requests, code review, and working across shared repositories.Experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js, SQL, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs is a plus, but we don't expect mastery of every technology in our stack. What matters more is being AI-native: using AI coding assistants as a core part of how you design, build, debug, and ship — and being able to learn unfamiliar systems and technologies quickly.




Strengthen your application with: links to GitHub repos, deployed applications, a technical portfolio, open-source contributions, or other projects that demonstrate your engineering ability. For candidates with professional experience, we'll weigh most heavily what you personally built, owned, and delivered — and the decisions and trade-offs behind that work.




Business Understanding & Judgement:Babaclick is an international commerce business, and our engineering function exists to solve real commercial and operational problems. Interviews will assess business judgement alongside technical skill.




 * Before interviewing, come prepared to discuss:What Babaclick does, and the markets we operate in
 * Why an international commerce business needs an internal engineering function
 * Where software, automation, data, and AI can create operational or commercial leverage
 * How your own experience could translate into value at Babaclick

We don't expect you to understand every part of our business going in — but we do expect you to have researched it, thought critically about how it operates, and arrived with informed questions and considered views. Technical ability is essential; commercial awareness and sound judgement matter just as much.




Recruitment Process: We assess: engineering fundamentals, professional experience, AI-assisted development capability, problem-solving, ability to navigate existing codebases, communication, business judgement, and ownership.




Come prepared to discuss past systems you've worked on in depth — your individual contribution, technical decisions, trade-offs, challenges, and impact.

title: Graduate Software Engineer, Open Source and Linux, Canonical Ubuntu
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring 2025 and 2026 Graduate Software Engineers into engineering teams around the world. As a global platform company we offer a wide range of software engineering challenges, in both open source products and commercial business systems. We have teams that work in a variety of languages, typically Python, Golang, Rust, C/C++, JavaScript and of course... Bash. We work from the very lowest levels of the Linux system - BIOS and boot loaders, firmware, kernel and drivers, all the way up to desktop applications and containers. We work on tiny devices like the Raspberry Pi and new RISC-V boards, all the way up to supercomputers, clouds and Kubernetes clusters. We work on compilers and toolchains, and we work on security, cryptography, performance and documentation. Some of our teams focus on packaging thousands of pieces of software, others focus on deep contributions to a single body of code.

If you are excited about the potential that open source has for humanity and the enterprise, you have outstanding results in your academic career, and you are excited to contribute to the open source stack, this is the best way to apply to Canonical. We will work with you to identify teams and projects that would be interesting and a good fit for your skills and motivations. The process is highly competitive, it will require effort and excellence to succeed if you apply here.

Most of our engineering teams work from home. We try to align a single team in a single time zone - EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa), APAC (Asia Pacific and Indian Ocean), and AMER (North, South and Central Americas). Even though you work from home, we try to ensure you always have colleagues alongside to coach and mentor you, and for the companionship of shared problem solving and pair programming. Larger projects have multiple teams and might span the globe. We work with the open source community and specialize in building teams that work well in the 'fishbowl' of open source engineering. This is full time work, five days a week, often solving hard problems with significant responsibility. We don't generally work weekends and nights and we do enjoy good holidays but we also expect productive and intense engagement Monday to Friday.

We bring all our engineering teams together in person twice a year for a deep 'sprint' with other teams to stimulate discussion and enable a wide range of career development paths. This is a fantastic way to demonstrate and develop your skill in software, learn about a wide range of technologies, make a meaningful impact to open source, and see some very interesting new cities that you might never otherwise get to visit.

If you find the open source stack amazing, and you have been a consistent high-performing student in your school and university, then this will be a challenging and exciting start to your career.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

The role entails


 * Shaping the roadmap for your product at global sprints every six months
 * Focusing on design and user experience, even for developer tooling and command line apps
 * Writing high quality, resilient and performant code, potentially serving millions of demanding daily users
 * Working towards mastery of key programming languages and Linux system knowledge
 * Engaging with users and the open source community through code reviews and issue trackers
 * Responding to customer issues as a priority, develop an understanding of enterprise requirements
 * Developing skills and awareness of security in software design and implementation
   
   
   

What we are looking for in you


 * Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
 * Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics or another STEM discipline with programming courses
 * Confidence to get started and deliver high quality code in one of Python, Rust, C/C++, Golang, JavaScript or Java
 * Experience with Ubuntu or another Linux distribution
 * Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
 * Result-oriented and organized, with the drive to meet commitments
 * Personal projects in technology and software engineering beyond the curriculum
 * Professional written and spoken English
 * Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
 * Personal responsibility and accountability
 * Thoughtfulness, self-awareness and the ability to reflect and develop
 * Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
   
   
   

Nice-to-have skills


 * Upstream open source contributions
 * Packaging and Linux distribution contributions - Debian, Fedora, Arch, Nix or another
 * Leadership and organization skills
 * Presentation and writing skills
 * Business and commercial interests
   
   
   

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.


 * Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
 * Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
 * Annual compensation review
 * Recognition rewards
 * Annual holiday leave
 * Maternity and paternity leave
 * Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
 * Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
 * Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
   
   
   

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

We leverage technology and advanced analytics to reduce the cost of delivering financial services by partnering with leading Telecom Operators, Banks, MFIs, Credit Bureaus, Mobile Financial Providers, and handset vendors.

Yabx was incubated by Mahindra Comviva and operates across The Hague, New Delhi, and Nairobi, bringing together a team of industry experts and entrepreneurs with global experience. Our mission is to build world-class, innovative products that meaningfully improve people’s lives.

Key Responsibilities


 * Design, build, and deploy LLM-powered applications including chatbots, assistants, and AI agents
 * Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python, FastAPI, or Flask
 * Implement RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval systems
 * Integrate Speech-to-Text (STT) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) technologies
 * Design conversation memory, context management, and session-handling mechanisms
 * Build real-time AI interaction systems using WebSockets or streaming APIs
 * Monitor, evaluate, and improve AI systems using prompt management and observability tools

title: Biology Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Biology Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based remotely in India.

Help shape the future of AI by applying your biology expertise to the training and evaluation of advanced language models. In this freelance project, you will challenge AI systems with complex scientific questions and realistic laboratory scenarios across a broad range of biological disciplines. Your assessments will help determine whether models provide scientifically accurate, logically sound, and reliable explanations. You will identify reasoning gaps, document reproducible errors, and recommend improvements to prompts and evaluation methods. Your contributions will support the development of AI systems that can better assist with scientific learning, research, and laboratory workflows. This remote opportunity is well suited to experienced biology professionals who enjoy analytical problem-solving and communicating complex scientific concepts clearly.

Accountabilities

As a Biology Specialist, you will evaluate AI-generated responses to scientific questions, investigate technical inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to improve model performance and scientific reasoning.


 * Test AI models using theoretical biology questions and realistic laboratory or research scenarios.
 * Evaluate responses across relevant disciplines, including cell biology, molecular biology, genetics, physiology, ecology, evolutionary biology, immunology, neurobiology, developmental biology, and biochemistry.
 * Assess scientific reasoning related to signal transduction, gene expression, protein folding, microscopy techniques, cloning methods, CRISPR and genome editing, laboratory protocols, and biosafety procedures.
 * Review explanations concerning biological systems and their roles in health and disease.
 * Verify factual accuracy, scientific validity, and logical consistency in AI-generated answers.
 * Identify and document model failure modes, including incorrect scientific claims, flawed assumptions, and gaps in reasoning.
 * Capture reproducible error traces and explain why specific responses are inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading.
 * Recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies to strengthen scientific reasoning.
 * Communicate your reasoning clearly by outlining relevant evidence, assumptions, and the steps supporting your conclusions.
   
   

Requirements

The ideal candidate has advanced knowledge of biology or a closely related life-science discipline, combined with strong analytical skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts in a structured, evidence-based manner. Research experience and practical laboratory expertise are valuable assets.


 * A PhD in biology or a closely related life-science field is preferred.
 * Strong knowledge of one or more biological specialties, such as cell biology, molecular biology, genetics, physiology, ecology, immunology, neurobiology, developmental biology, evolutionary biology, or biochemistry.
 * Experience in scientific research, wet-lab experimentation, field research, laboratory diagnostics, or related practical projects is an advantage.
 * Peer-reviewed publications or other evidence of scientific expertise are beneficial.
 * Familiarity with relevant techniques and concepts, such as gene expression, protein folding, microscopy, cloning, CRISPR, genome editing, laboratory protocols, and biosafety procedures.
 * Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify scientific inaccuracies and evaluate complex reasoning.
 * Excellent written communication skills and the ability to explain scientific concepts step by step.
 * A meticulous, evidence-driven approach to evaluating responses and documenting errors.

Our Enterprise Capability team is a strategic extension of AECOM's global business, delivering services to multidisciplinary projects across the UK and other international markets.

You will play a key role in supporting ecology projects while developing the technical, analytical and consultancy skills needed for a successful career in nature consulting.

Unlike many graduate ecology roles, this position offers immediate exposure to internationally significant projects, multidisciplinary teams, and global environmental best practice. You will work directly with experienced ecologists, planners, engineers and landscape architects while building consulting skills that are highly valued across international environmental and sustainability markets.

Working remotely as an integrated member of one of our regional ecology teams, you will receive structured training, mentoring and personalised career development support from experienced professionals dedicated to helping you succeed.

Here’s what you’ll do

As an Assistant Ecologist, you will contribute to a diverse range of ecological assessments and environmental projects by:

 * Conducting desk-based ecological studies, including researching designated sites, habitats, and protected species records.

At AECOM, you'll be part of a thriving Nature business comprising more than 230 specialists across ecology, arboriculture, forestry, groundwater and surface water disciplines. Our team includes recognised industry leaders and technical experts who are shaping the future of environmental consultancy.

You'll benefit from:

 * Direct collaboration with ecological specialists across the UK and global regions.
 * Exposure to nationally significant infrastructure, renewable energy, transportation and water projects.
 * Structured technical learning through formal training programmes and mentoring.
 * Access to global knowledge networks and subject matter experts.
 * Opportunities to build long-term international consulting careers.
 * A culture focused on sustainability, innovation and continuous learning.
 * Clear progression pathways from Assistant Ecologist through to Specialist and Project Ecologist roles.
   
   

This role is designed as an entry point into AECOM's global Nature practice. Successful candidates will have opportunities to develop into technical specialists, project ecologists and future environmental consulting leaders through structured development programmes and project experience.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Here’s what we’re looking for:

 * Undergraduate degree in a related discipline such as:
 * Ecology
 * Environmental Science
 * Environmental Management
 * Zoology
 * Botany
 * Conservation Biology
 * Wildlife Sciences
 * Forestry
 * Natural Resource Management
 * Geography (Environmental)
 * Sustainability Studies
 * Earth and Environmental Sciences
   
   

Or a related subject

 * Passion for ecology and environmental conservation.
 * Good understanding of core ecological principles, including:
 * Ecological survey and assessment methods
 * Ecological impact assessment principles
 * Mitigation hierarchy
 * Habitat management and restoration
 * Ecosystem services and nature recovery concepts
   
   

Knowledge of Biodiversity Net Gain and biodiversity offsetting approaches is advantageous but not essential.

Desirable

Experience of ecological consultancy, a knowledge of UK nature conservation legislation; and an understanding of UK habitats and protected species are desirable but not essential.

We welcome candidates with strong ecological foundations and a willingness to learn international environmental consulting practices.

At AECOM, we are committed to delivering a better world through sustainable infrastructure, environmental stewardship and climate resilience. title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Agentic AI & Workflow Engineering




Experience: 3–4 years of total relevant experience

Location: Dubai, UAE

Department: Data Science & AI Innovation

Employment Type: Full-time




We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to develop and deploy enterprise AI applications, with a strong focus on Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), AI agents, and automated business workflows.




The role combines LLM application development with strong Python engineering, practical system design, and foundational DevOps skills. You will translate business requirements into reliable AI services, integrating models, tools, enterprise data, and human-review steps.

You should be comfortable taking a feature from design and implementation through testing, cloud deployment, and production troubleshooting, working closely with senior engineers, data scientists, and business teams.




Key Responsibilities

 * Develop AI Agents and Workflows

Build single-agent and multi-agent applications using Google ADK. Implement sequential, parallel, conditional, and iterative workflows, combining LLM-driven tasks with deterministic Python logic. Manage agent delegation, session state, and context across workflow steps.

 * Engineer LLM and RAG Applications

Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), document-processing, and structured-extraction pipelines. Implement prompt and context management, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, and schema-validated outputs. Improve response relevance, grounding, latency, and cost through systematic testing.

 * Design Reliable Backend Services

Build modular APIs and services using Python and FastAPI. Contribute to system design covering service boundaries, API contracts, data models, asynchronous processing, background jobs, caching, and concurrency. Implement timeouts, bounded retries, and safeguards against duplicate processing.

 * Integrate Tools and Enterprise Systems

Develop reusable agent tools that connect to databases, document repositories, and business APIs. Use function calling and, where appropriate, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, with clear input schemas, authentication, access controls, and error handling.

 * Implement Human Review and Safety Controls

Build approval checkpoints and escalation paths for sensitive actions or outputs requiring business validation. Support workflows that pause for human input and resume with the appropriate state. Apply input validation, output checks, and least-privilege tool access.

 * Evaluate and Monitor AI Workflows

Create representative evaluation datasets and regression tests for output quality, tool selection, and workflow completion. Use logs, traces, and metrics to investigate failures and monitor latency, token usage, and cost. Validate changes to prompts, models, and workflows before release.

 * Support Cloud Deployment and DevOps

Containerize applications using Docker and deploy AI services to cloud environments, preferably GCP Cloud Run. Maintain basic CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, secrets, health checks, and rollback procedures in collaboration with platform teams. Google’s ADK deployment guidance supports container-based deployment to Cloud Run.

Required Qualifications and Skills

Education and Experience

 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
 * 3–4 years of total experience focussed in AI engineering, backend development, or software engineering, including hands-on delivery of LLM or agent-based applications.
 * Demonstrable experience deploying and supporting applications beyond notebooks or proof-of-concept demonstrations.




Core Technical Skills




 * Python and backend engineering

Strong Python programming, asynchronous execution, REST APIs, FastAPI, Pydantic, exception handling, and maintainable code organization.

 * Google ADK and agent development

Hands-on experience building agents, custom tools, and multi-step workflows; working knowledge of sessions, state, context management, callbacks, and agent execution.

 * LLM application engineering

Practical experience with model APIs, prompt and context engineering, function calling, structured outputs, embeddings, and RAG.

 * System design

Ability to explain an end-to-end application design and justify choices around APIs, storage, queues, caching, scalability, security, and failure recovery.

 * Data and integrations

Working knowledge of SQL, REST integrations, document-processing pipelines, and at least one vector database or vector-search service.

 * DevOps fundamentals

Docker, Git, Linux basics, CI/CD, environment configuration, secrets management, and cloud deployment troubleshooting.

 * Testing and debugging

Unit and integration testing, API debugging, log analysis, and evaluation of AI outputs and workflow behavior.




Preferred Skills

 * Experience with ADK or LangGraph or comparable orchestration frameworks, alongside familiarity with graph-based workflows and persistent execution state.
 * Exposure to MCP for tool integration and Agent2Agent (A2A) for communication between independently deployed agents.
 * Familiarity with Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, BigQuery, or MongoDB Atlas, and streaming interfaces such as server-sent events or WebSockets.
 * Exposure to infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, multimodal document processing, or AI security tooling. Advanced platform administration and model fine-tuning are not core requirements.




Working Style

We value engineers who break ambiguous requirements into manageable tasks, communicate design trade-offs clearly, and take ownership of implementation quality. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams, participating in code reviews, documenting your work, and learning new AI capabilities without adding unnecessary architectural complexity.




The ideal candidate can design, build, deploy, and troubleshoot a practical AI workflow—and explain how its quality, reliability, security, and operating cost will be measured.
